questions.questionText: Why do large increases in the temperature or pH alter enzyme activity?

Ethylene glycol is a chemical used to prevent water from freezing. If ethylene glycol is swallowed accidentally, it is metabolised by an enzyme found in liver cells to produce a toxic product. The enzyme normally catalyses the oxidation of ethanol to a harmless product. People who have swallowed ethylene glycol are treated with large doses of ethanol. This prevents formation of a toxic product and allows the body to excrete the ethylene glycol. Which statement describes why this treatment works?

options.A: Ethanol binds near the active site on the enzyme, altering its shape.
options.B: Ethanol binds permanently to the active site of the enzyme, blocking it.
options.C: Ethanol changes the tertiary structure of the enzyme, denaturing it.
options.D: Ethanol is more likely to bind to the active site on the enzyme.

questions.questionText: In plants adapted to cold conditions, their cell surface membranes change as the weather gets colder, allowing the plants to carry out exocytosis. Which change occurs in their cell surface membranes?

options.A: a decrease in the ratio of proteins to saturated phospholipids
options.B: a decrease in the ratio of unsaturated phospholipids to saturated phospholipids
options.C: an increase in the ratio of proteins to unsaturated phospholipids
options.D: an increase in the ratio of unsaturated phospholipids to saturated phospholipids

questions.questionText: Which statement about a diploid cell is not correct?

options.A: It can undergo a mitotic division to allow growth to occur.
options.B: It can undergo a mitotic division to repair a cell.
options.C: It can undergo a reduction division to form haploid cells.
options.D: It is one that possesses two complete sets of chromosomes.

questions.questionText: Laboratory mice whose p53 genes had been switched off developed tumours. When their p53 genes were switched on again, the tumour cells stopped dividing and died within a few days. Healthy cells in the mice were unaffected. What do these observations suggest?

options.A: p53 protein speeds up the mitotic cell cycle
options.B: p53 protein causes all cells to die
options.C: the p53 gene acts as a tumour suppressor gene
options.D: the p53 gene encourages the growth of tumours

In a freshwater food chain, which involves the least efficient energy transfer?

options.B: Small fishes feed on the water fleas.
options.C: Unicellular algae trap sunlight.
options.D: Water fleas feed on the unicellular algae.

questions.questionText: Which statement concerning events occurring in the nitrogen cycle is not correct?

options.A: Free-living nitrogen-fixing bacteria release organic nitrogen compounds into the soil where bacteria convert these to nitrites and nitrates.
options.B: Nitrifying bacteria cause an increase in nitrate ions which are used by plants to make proteins.
options.C: Nitrogen-fixing bacteria use atmospheric nitrogen which is replaced by the action of denitrifying bacteria in waterlogged soil.
options.D: Saprophytic bacteria and fungi decompose organic nitrogen compounds excreted and egested by producers and consumers.
